sections.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِIn the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.BY THE GRACE AND INFINITE BLESSINGS OF ALLAH (SWT)Daawat-e-WalimaFahad Masood&Rahnuma ZarrinSunday15 November 2026REGAL PALACE · TANDA

WITH LOVE, GRATITUDE & JOYAn invitation from our heartsWith hearts filled with gratitude and joy,Mr. Masood Alam and Mrs. Rubeena Shamimrequest the honour of your gracious presence at theDAAWAT-E-WALIMAcelebrating the blessed marriage of their beloved sonFahad MasoodBeloved son of Mr. Masood Alam and Mrs. Rubeena ShamimRahnuma ZarrinBeloved daughter of Mrs. Shamshad BegumWith gratitude to Almighty Allah for His countless blessings, we invite you to share in our happiness as two hearts begin a beautiful journey together.

WITH THE COMPLIMENTS OF OUR FAMILYR.S.V.P.Afroz AlamAnwar AlamMasood AlamShahzad AlamShahnawaz AlamMohd MonisShahmeer AlamYour gracious presence and heartfelt duas will make this joyous celebration truly memorable.

وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا“And We created you in pairs.”A translation of Surah An-Naba (78:8)May Allah bless this union with lasting love, mercy, peace, and barakah. Ameen.With warm regards,Mr. Masood Alam and Mrs. Rubeena ShamimDAAWAT-E-WALIMA · 15 NOVEMBER 2026

metadata.description: By the grace of Allah, join Mr. Masood Alam and Mrs. Rubeena Shamim for the Daawat-e-Walima of Fahad Masood & Rahnuma Zarrin. Sunday, 15 November 2026, 6:00 PM IST onwards, Regal Palace, Asopur, Tanda.
